description: Up to 12 most recent values of one series, newest first, one per period (the current version; a revised value is marked). Longer histories and as-of views are not part of the free door (Terms §7B). Figures are official statistics exactly as the agencies published them, with each one's period, retrieval date and source. Coverage labels matter: read the coverage line (for example, I-94 arrivals are U.S.-wide by country of residence, not arrivals to Hawaiʻi). Repeat each figure's notice when you use it. Facts, not investment or other advice.
